esplink_ble_begin.tooltip: Start the BLE host through the ESP32-C3 controller; the ESPLink connection is opened automatically

esplink_ble_end.tooltip: Stop BLE without affecting WiFi on the same link

esplink_ble_poll.tooltip: Advance the BLE host and run callbacks; BLE blocks add this automatically

esplink_ble_connected.tooltip: Whether a BLE connection exists; this port supports one connection at a time

esplink_ble_set_timeout.tooltip: Waiting time for scanning, connecting and similar operations

esplink_ble_healthy.tooltip: Whether the controller link is usable; restart BLE after a session change or queue overflow

esplink_ble_last_error.tooltip: Last error reported by the BLE transport; 0 means success

esplink_ble_create_service.tooltip: Create a local GATT service object

esplink_ble_create_characteristic.message0: create BLE numeric characteristic %1 UUID %2 type %3
esplink_ble_create_characteristic.tooltip: Create a fixed-size numeric characteristic object

esplink_ble_create_string_characteristic.message0: create BLE text characteristic %1 UUID %2 max length %3
esplink_ble_create_string_characteristic.tooltip: Create a string characteristic; the length is bounded by the 242 byte ATT MTU

esplink_ble_service_add_characteristic.tooltip: Add a characteristic to a service before the service is registered

esplink_ble_add_service.tooltip: Add the service to the local GATT database

esplink_ble_set_local_name.tooltip: Name shown in the scan response

esplink_ble_set_device_name.tooltip: Value of the GAP device name characteristic

esplink_ble_set_advertised_service.tooltip: Publish the service UUID in the advertising packet so centrals can filter by it

esplink_ble_advertise.tooltip: Start advertising; call it after registering the services

esplink_ble_set_advertising_interval.tooltip: A longer interval saves power but is discovered more slowly

esplink_ble_set_connectable.tooltip: When off, the device advertises but refuses connections

esplink_ble_char_write_number.tooltip: Update a local numeric characteristic; subscribed peers are notified

esplink_ble_char_value_number.tooltip: Current value of a local numeric characteristic

esplink_ble_char_value_string.tooltip: Current content of a local string characteristic

esplink_ble_char_written.tooltip: Whether a peer wrote to this characteristic; the flag clears when read

esplink_ble_char_subscribed.tooltip: Whether a peer subscribed to notifications of this characteristic

esplink_ble_on_char_written.tooltip: Runs when a peer writes this characteristic; the handler runs in the task servicing BLE, so keep it short

esplink_ble_on_device_event.tooltip: Handler for connect and disconnect events

esplink_ble_scan.tooltip: Scan for every discoverable BLE device nearby

esplink_ble_scan_for.message0: start scanning for BLE devices by %1 matching %2
esplink_ble_scan_for.tooltip: Report only devices matching the filter

esplink_ble_stop_scan.tooltip: Stop scanning; scanning must be stopped before connecting

esplink_ble_device_create.tooltip: Take one discovered device; the variable stays invalid when there is none

esplink_ble_device_found.tooltip: Whether this device variable refers to a real device

esplink_ble_device_connect.tooltip: Connect to the device; true on success. Stop scanning first

esplink_ble_device_discover.tooltip: Read the services and characteristics of the peer; required after connecting

esplink_ble_device_connected.tooltip: Whether the device is still connected

esplink_ble_device_local_name.tooltip: Name from the advertising packet; empty when no name is advertised

esplink_ble_device_rssi.tooltip: Signal strength of the peer in dBm

esplink_ble_remote_char_create.tooltip: Take a peer characteristic by UUID; discover the services first

esplink_ble_remote_can.tooltip: Query what the remote characteristic supports

esplink_ble_remote_read.tooltip: Request a read from the peer; the result is kept in the local cache

esplink_ble_remote_value_number.tooltip: Interpret the cached bytes as an integer according to the value length

esplink_ble_remote_value_string.tooltip: Read the cached bytes as text

esplink_ble_remote_write_number.tooltip: Write a 4 byte integer to the peer characteristic

esplink_ble_remote_write_string.tooltip: Write text to the peer characteristic

esplink_ble_remote_subscribe.tooltip: Subscribe to notifications; true on success

esplink_ble_remote_value_updated.tooltip: Whether a new notification arrived after subscribing

esplink_begin.tooltip: Start the link on the board's default hardware UART at 921600 baud. The WiFi and BLE libraries start ESPLink automatically; use this block for standalone diagnostics

esplink_begin_serial.tooltip: Start ESPLink on an explicit UART and baud. It must match the C3 firmware baud and run before WiFi/BLE setup

esplink_bind_stream.tooltip: Borrow a serial port the sketch already configured (custom pins). ESPLink never calls its begin() or end()

esplink_end.tooltip: Release the ESPLink binding. In borrowed mode the serial driver stays open

esplink_poll.tooltip: Advance the ESPLink transport. Startup blocks add this to the main loop automatically

esplink_ready.tooltip: Whether the C3 link holds a usable session

esplink_ping.tooltip: Send one ping to the C3 and wait for the reply

esplink_session.tooltip: Current link session id. A change means the C3 restarted or the link was rebuilt, and all earlier sockets and BLE handles are invalid

esplink_last_error.tooltip: Error code of the last ESPLink operation; 0 means success

esplink_error_code.tooltip: ESPLink error constant, for comparison with the last error code

esplink_firmware_version.tooltip: Version string of the bridge firmware running on the ESP32-C3

esplink_capability.tooltip: Read a capability value reported during the C3 handshake

esplink_has_feature.tooltip: Whether the C3 firmware supports the selected feature

esplink_stat.tooltip: Read link quality counters to troubleshoot wiring and baud problems
